lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Mr. Gourmand,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I'm curious...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Do you like Emma's cooking?
Emma's cooking?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Yeah!
What makes you ask?????

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Why are you using so many question marks?
Oh... I was just caught off guard is all, hehe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Oh, okay, hehe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It's nothing major.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Emma brought a dish over.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: She said she made it while watching my program.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: The thing is,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: what I made on the show were egg tarts,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: but what she gave me was more like black chunks of coal.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: The most surprising thing though,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: is that she truly did make it with love and dedication,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and she really did follow the show while she made it.
Wow.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: she used twice as many different ingredients as the ones I outlined on the show.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: She also added a few extra steps in the cooking process.
Doesn't sound to me like she followed the show...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Cooking isn't an exact science.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: As long as it makes you happy and others find it delicious,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: that's all that matters.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I believe that's why Emma continues to make those unique dishes of hers.
Oh?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: People enjoy eating Emma's food.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Since Emma feels that people enjoy her cooking,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: she has more motivation to keep striving to improve.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: That's the emotion you can taste in her food.
Wow...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I asked her,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and she said that you also enjoyed it.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: She specifically named you, Bonne Bouche.
Well, she asked me to try it, and so I had to be nice...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I knew you were someone who respected all kinds of different foods and tastes.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: we've decided we should support Emma in her cooking ventures.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: In this world, no two individuals' taste buds are the same.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Everyone has different preferences.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I'm sure there will be a demand for Emma's cooking,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: and she'll be able to cook away quite happily, hehe.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Personally,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I really enjoyed the sense of affection

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: conveyed through her cooking,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and plan to eat it from time to time.
Are you serious?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: The flavor is simple, but that's precisely what I enjoy.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: And I respect anyone who dedicates themselves to cooking.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: You also enjoy her cooking, Mr. Gourmand,

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: so we should all cheer her on together!
Okay...
